core_question: How do I keep cut apple slices from turning brown before serving? (secondary: How do I keep an embedded video from starting on its own during a slideshow?)
answer_summary: Toss freshly cut apple slices in lemon juice, or soak briefly in water mixed with citrus juice, so the acid slows the enzymatic browning reaction that darkens exposed flesh.; after the topic shift: Select the video, open Playback options, and change Start from 'Automatically' to 'On Click' so it only plays when clicked.
